name: young_man_peace_sign
positive: A flat vector illustration of a young man with dark wavy hair and a short goatee, head and shoulders portrait, his hand raised beside his face clearly visible inside the frame, showing a clear peace sign: the index finger and middle finger raised and separated in a V shape, ring finger and pinky folded down against the palm, thumb resting across them. He is looking at the camera with a playful expression. He is wearing a light cream or beige shirt with an open collar. The art style is minimalist, clean, with flat color blocks and simple black outlines. Pure white background. Minimalist character design, generous white space around the subject, 1x1
